helpByCategory.rings: Not sure of your ring size? Wrap a strip of paper around your finger, mark where it meets and measure it. 52mm is a size 6, 54mm a 7, 57mm an 8, 59mm a 9 and 62mm a 10.
helpByCategory.necklaces: Chain length is measured from end to end. 16 inch sits at the collarbone, 18 inch just below it and 20 inch on the chest.
helpByCategory.bracelets: Measure around your wrist and add about half an inch for a comfortable fit.
helpByCategory.watches: The size is the width of the watch case. 36mm suits a slimmer wrist, 40mm and 42mm a broader one.
